steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required for the event.

args.goal: On the single-stage create screen, open Add Attachments, upload sample.pdf and sample.png, remove sample.pdf using its delete control, and stop with exactly sample.png listed in the attachments area

steps.note: Perform the attachment upload and deletion flow that has no dedicated catalog step.
Add one QA vendor participant so the event can be published and its vendor view inspected.
Confirm publication reached the real project page.
Verify the remaining attachment is listed on the buyer's published project details.
Verify the removed attachment is no longer listed on the buyer's project details.
Inspect the event from the invited vendor portal.
Open the vendor's event overview where shared attachments are visible.
Verify the remaining attachment is visible to the vendor.
Verify the removed attachment is not visible to the vendor.
